notes.title: Patch Notes Vol.001
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156462/569b64649252b7db43b183d2b9dcfcea47f119dc.png[/img]

Hello, Glass fans!

We are pleased to announce that we have patch for Glass Zero.

Tired of exiting in fullscreen and having to return to the windowed screen first?
Now you can quit the game directly from fullscreen.

It's a small patch, but we hope it helps...

Our programmer have been having a hard time getting out and about lately due to the snow.
We hope you're all staying healthy.
We'll try to stay strong and make your gaming experience more enjoyable.

Thank you.
